scope: framework-level performance/runtime optimization for VIBE candidate evaluation; domain-specific benchmark values are fixtures only

quality.purpose: correctness, analyst burden, artifact quality, architecture and generalization

performance.purpose: wall-clock, duplicate work, graph steps, compile/inspect overhead, gap-loop cost and model execution overhead

invariants: performance optimization must not change the active score regime
performance optimization must not suppress consequential gaps or worsen analyst experience
performance optimization must not weaken provenance, conflict, grounding, lineage, unknown-preservation or source-contract checks
performance-only changes require controlled equivalence evidence before acceptance

one_pass_model_execution.rule: when runtime supports an in-process model callback, continue the same runtime traversal from the actual model-node execution point using the exact runtime-effective input
one_pass_model_execution.pseudo_live_binding: synthetic response remains PSEUDO_LIVE_SYNTHETIC and is bound to exact effective-input hash

restart_from_zero.fallback: allowed only when the runtime cannot continue in-process; record runtime_restart_count and classify the overhead as orchestration cost

requirements: output order is not semantic input
parallelism.dependent_graph_steps: do not parallelize without deterministic proof of equivalence

time_degradation.trigger: current wall time exceeds configured multiplier of recent valid median while semantic complexity delta is small, or deterministic repeated-work signals are present

gap_loop_fusion.target: repeated deterministic normalize -> audit -> auto-resolve -> gate stages
gap_loop_fusion.acceptance: controlled same-scenario A/B with artifact/score/gap equivalence and consistent timing improvement
gap_loop_fusion.default_action: do not fuse during ordinary quality revision

stop_rules.after_convergence: freeze best exact candidate and proceed to next lifecycle stage rather than revision churn

pseudo_live_live_acceptance.offline: many pseudo-live iterations may run with exact-input-bound blind synthetic responses
pseudo_live_live_acceptance.live: formal Live Acceptance is reserved for the frozen offline best after convergence/promotion gates
pseudo_live_live_acceptance.fidelity_gap: when Live Acceptance materially differs from pseudo-live prediction, register SIMULATION_FIDELITY_GAP; never post-hoc tune stored synthetic responses
